user_query.description: The user's natural language query about finding properties. Used only as a fallback to recover an area/criteria when structured params are missing.
user_query.title: User Query

area.description: Where the user wants to LIVE / the search area (e.g. Camden, Manchester, or a university like UCL). This (or commute_destination) is the only thing truly needed.
area.title: Area

areas.description: OPTIONAL multiple residential areas to search at once (e.g. ["Camden", "Islington"]). Use when the user wants to compare several neighbourhoods. The single "area" is treated as the first of these; results are tagged with the area each listing came from.
areas.title: Areas

location.description: LEGACY alias. Treated as the search area; if it names a university (e.g. UCL) it also becomes the commute-annotation target. Prefer "area" and/or "commute_destination".
location.title: Location

commute_destination.description: Where the user commutes TO (e.g. UCL, London Bridge). Optional. When given, commute times are annotated (and filtered only if max_commute_time is a real limit). If no area is given, the search area is derived from this.
commute_destination.title: Commute Destination

no_commute.description: Set true when the user explicitly does NOT commute / just lives there / works from home (e.g. "我不通勤我单纯住着", "wfh"). Disables all commute computation, filtering and questions.
no_commute.title: No Commute

bedrooms.description: Explicit bedroom count (0 = studio). Optional; when omitted the tool infers from the message or defaults to a broad range.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

bedrooms_minimum.description: True when bedrooms is a minimum, rather than an exact count.
bedrooms_minimum.title: Bedrooms Minimum

max_budget.description: OPTIONAL maximum monthly budget in GBP (e.g., 1500, 2000). Omit for no budget filter — never blocks the search.
max_budget.title: Max Budget

max_commute_time.description: OPTIONAL maximum commute time in minutes. ONLY provide if the user explicitly states a limit AND has a commute destination. Omit for no commute filter — never blocks the search.
max_commute_time.title: Max Commute Time

care_about_safety.description: Whether user cares about area safety/crime rates.
care_about_safety.title: Care About Safety

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.
limit.title: Limit

current_message.description: The raw text of ONLY this turn's user message (no injected memory/history). Used to let an explicit budget/commute stated this turn override accumulated values.
current_message.title: Current Message

property_features.description: Accumulated property features (e.g. studio, en-suite) carried across turns.
property_features.title: Property Features

accumulated_preferences.description: Accumulated soft preferences carried across turns.
accumulated_preferences.title: Accumulated Preferences

room_type.description: OPTIONAL preferred room type: 'studio', 'ensuite', or 'shared' (omit for any). Studio also implies a 0-bedroom search.
room_type.title: Room Type

move_in_date.description: OPTIONAL desired move-in / tenancy-start date as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Never blocks the search: when omitted, every listing still shows its availability; when provided, listings are annotated for fit (available on/before it) and later-only ones are demoted but not excluded. The tool also parses an explicit move-in date stated in the current message.
move_in_date.title: Move In Date

confirmed.description: Set true when the user has explicitly confirmed to proceed (chat "continue"/"搜索") or when called from the criteria-panel Search button (/api/search_direct). Bypasses the soft criteria gate.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

criteria_gate_shown.description: Injected by the agent from accumulated criteria: true once the soft criteria gate has already been shown in this conversation (so it fires at most once).
criteria_gate_shown.title: Criteria Gate Shown

reply_language.description: OPTIONAL reply-language override: 'zh' or 'en'. When set it FORCES every user-facing string (found summary, gate question, no-results, similar-fallback) into that language instead of inferring from the current message. The app sets it from the reply-language policy (current message CJK, else the frontend UI language); omit to keep the message-based inference.
reply_language.title: Reply Language

to_address.description: 目的地址（工作地点、学校等）
to_address.title: To Address

mode.description: 通勤方式: transit (地铁/公交/火车), driving (开车), walking (步行), bicycling (骑车). 注意：不要使用 tube/tubing/underground，请用 transit
mode.title: Mode

from_address.description: 起点地址（房源完整地址，包括门牌号、街道名、城市、邮编）
from_address.title: From Address

to_address.description: 终点地址（学校/工作地点完整地址）
to_address.title: To Address

travel_type.description: 乘客类型。学生使用 18+ Student Oyster Card 可享受 Travelcard 30% 折扣
travel_type.title: Travel Type

mode.description: 通勤方式。注意：只有 transit (公共交通) 才会计算交通费用
mode.title: Mode

address.description: 要检查的完整地址或区域名称（如 "Stratford, London" 或 "Scape Bloomsbury, 19-29 Woburn Place, London"）
address.title: Address

area.description: 区域名称（address 的别名，可以使用 address 或 area 任意一个）
area.title: Area

latitude.description: 纬度（可选，如果不提供会自动解析地址）
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: 经度（可选，如果不提供会自动解析地址）
longitude.title: Longitude

user_query.description: 用户原始查询（用于检测语言）
user_query.title: User Query

query.description: 主查询语句（英文）。示例: 'Scape Bloomsbury safety and amenities'
query.title: Query

tool.description: 允许的只读工具名称；web_search 本身不可嵌套

params.description: 工具参数（有界 JSON object）

sub_queries.description: 子查询列表（可选）。每个子查询包含 tool 和 params
sub_queries.title: Sub Queries

poi_type.description: Type(s) of POI, COMMA-SEPARATED for several at once (e.g. "supermarket,convenience,tube_station"). One call covering every type you need is much faster than one call per type. Known types: restaurant, chinese_restaurant, supermarket, convenience, cafe, pharmacy, gym, park, bus_stop, tube_station, bank, atm, or "all"
poi_type.title: Poi Type

radius.description: Search radius in meters (default 300, max 800). Keep it tight: "nearby" means walking distance, and a wider circle is slower for no better answer.
radius.title: Radius

user_query.description: Original user query for smart POI type inference
user_query.title: User Query

latitude.description: The listing's own latitude, if you have it (get_property_details returns geo_location). Passing it skips geocoding, so the radius is centred on the property itself instead of a street or district centre.
latitude.title: Latitude

property_url.description: 房产 URL（首选）。推荐索引/搜索结果里每条都带 URL，直接传它可精确命中缓存里那一条房源。
property_url.title: Property Url

property_name.description: 房产名称，如 'Scape Bloomsbury', 'iQ Bloomsbury', 'Tufnell House' 等
property_name.title: Property Name

property_address.description: 房产地址或部分地址，如 '19-29 Woburn Place' 或 'London WC1H'
property_address.title: Property Address

question.description: 房产相关的具体问题（可选），如 '是不是studio？' 或 '访客政策是什么？'
question.title: Question

end_zone.description: The furthest zone (e.g., 2, 3, 4, 5, 6). Usually start_zone is 1.
end_zone.title: End Zone

travel_type.description: Type of passenger. Use 'student' for 18+ Student Oyster Card holders.
travel_type.title: Travel Type

query_type.description: What to look up. 'auto' infers it from user_query.
query_type.title: Query Type

from_location.description: Journey start: station, postcode, place or address.
from_location.title: From Location

to_location.description: Journey destination: station, postcode, place or address.
to_location.title: To Location

line.description: Tube/rail line name for a status check (e.g. 'Victoria'). Empty = all lines.
line.title: Line

end_zone.description: Furthest London fare zone for a Travelcard (2-6).
end_zone.title: End Zone

user_query.description: Original user question (used to auto-infer query_type).
user_query.title: User Query

query.description: what to recall about the user
query.title: Query

n.description: max number of memories to return
n.title: N

user_id.description: current user identity (REQUIRED for per-user memory; injected by the agent runtime)
user_id.title: User Id

content.description: the durable fact to remember about the user
content.title: Content

user_id.description: current user identity (REQUIRED for per-user memory; injected by the agent runtime)
user_id.title: User Id

question.description: the clarifying question to show the user, in the user's language
question.title: Question

clarification_kind.description: what kind of clarification this is
clarification_kind.title: Clarification Kind

city.description: City to compare areas within (e.g. Manchester, London). Provide this or destination.
city.title: City

destination.description: A commute destination (university/workplace, e.g. UCL) whose nearby areas to rank; enables the commute dimension.
destination.title: Destination

max_commute_minutes.description: Optional commute-time cap (minutes) to the destination.
max_commute_minutes.title: Max Commute Minutes

budget_hint.description: Optional budget used for the budget-match rate and value scoring.
budget_hint.title: Budget Hint

priorities.description: Ranking priorities, leading one weighted heaviest. safety/amenities are excluded when no cheap data is available.
priorities.title: Priorities

candidate_areas.description: Optional explicit areas to compare; when absent, candidates are generated from the destination/city.
candidate_areas.title: Candidate Areas
